summary: Iter 18 — Planning full write access edge cases (recurring check-ins, existing_item_updates, consolidations). Backend: 9/9 pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_planning_write_access.py) green — exclusive-safety on existing_item_updates (goal untouched, applied_existing_updates excludes id), exclusive-safety on consolidations (exclusive goal survives intact, richness-chosen survivor from non-exclusive candidates, silent skip when only 1 non-excl remains), weekday Mon/Wed/Fri recurrence over Aug 10–23 window produces exactly 6 check-ins with correct weekday + type='goal' + goal_id/expected_outcome_id set, empty days_of_week over 5-day window produces exactly 5 check-ins, type='life' recurrence creates check-ins with goal_id/project_id/expected_outcome_id all null (no anchor required), badly-formed proposal (missing time, invalid checkin type, unknown patch key, single-candidate consolidation, garbage status, end<start recurrence) returns 200 with empty apply buckets and real goal unchanged, current planning target survives when included in consolidations, reparent correctness verified (EO count summed onto survivor + child check-ins moved), materialize is not re-runnable on same message_id (400), losers 404 and survivor 200. Frontend smoke: injected proposal directly into db.plan_conversations and navigated to /planning/goal/{id} as test@hymn.app — proposal card rendered with testID=planning-proposal-{msg_id}, 'Recurring check-ins' label + date range 2026-08-10 → 2026-08-14 + time 07:00 + 'every day' badge visible; MERGE badge + 'Hymn will keep the richest and merge the rest.' caption visible under Consolidations section; Apply button testID=planning-apply-{msg_id} present.
critical_code_review_comments: planning_engine._materialize_proposal: exclusive-item guard is applied inside the existing_item_updates loop (line ~1013) AND inside consolidations candidate filter (line ~1069) — both verified via DB pre/post state assertions.

consolidations survivor is chosen deterministically by richness score (higher wins, older created_at tiebreak). Losers are deleted after reparenting expected_outcomes + checkins (goal) or tasks + checkins (project). Survivor's notes/description are merged with loser content if not already present. Verified: EO count on survivor = sum(EO counts of all candidates); survivor GET → 200, losers GET → 404.

_iter_dates correctly handles empty vs non-empty days_of_week (empty list is normalized to None → every day) and iterates inclusively over [start_date, end_date]. Weekday indexing matches datetime.weekday() (Monday=0).
materialize is guarded by target_msg['materialized_at'] and returns 400 on second call — confirmed in TestMaterializeIdempotencyAndConsolidation.

Badly-formed proposal handling: unknown patch keys are filtered via VALID_UPDATE_FIELDS; invalid status strings filtered per-kind; single-candidate consolidations skipped by len(candidates) < 2 check; recurrences with missing time / invalid dates fall through the guard and never insert. No 500s observed under any adversarial input tested.
